Character art, sounds and animation data come from the Microsoft Agent characters as packaged by
https://github.com/pithings/clippy (MIT, see LICENCE-pithings-clippy.js) and
https://github.com/vchaindz/modern-clippy (MIT, see LICENSE-modern-clippy.txt); animation concepts
(branching, exit branching, balloon, agent states) also follow https://github.com/Cosmo/Clippy.
The characters themselves are Microsoft trademarks/IP - personal, non-commercial use only.

|---|---|---|
| tux | Tux by Larry Ewing (made with The GIMP), SVG redraw by Garrett LeSage, Simon Budig / IFo Hancroft — [Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tux.svg) | Free use/modification if the artists are acknowledged |
| konqi | Konqi by Tyson Tan for KDE — [KDE mascot page](https://community.kde.org/Promo/Material/Mascots) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

| wilber | Wilber (GIMP mascot) by Matvizz, [Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gimp-wilber-scalable.svg) | CC0 |

Not included: the Mandrake/Mandriva mascot — its artwork was proprietary ("all copyrights reserved") and no free release was found.
